name: 菊花梨
description: 看起来像梨，闻起来像梨，尝起来味道也像梨。睡觉的时候会把身体藏在泥巴里，只把花朵留在地面上。小黄蜂想要来授粉的话它会非常苦恼。
descriptionEn: It looks like a pear, smells like a pear, and tastes like a pear too. When it sleeps it hides its body in the mud, leaving only its flower above ground. If a little wasp comes to pollinate it, it becomes very distressed.

skills.name: 碰爪
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 重击
skills.description: 造成物伤，每次使用后，本技能能耗永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. After each use, this skill's energy cost is permanently +1.

skills.name: 反弹
skills.description: 将自己的萌化转移给敌方。
skills.descriptionEn: Transfers its own Cutify to the enemy.

skills.name: 撒娇
skills.description: 造成魔伤，3连击。自己获得萌化：威力永久+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, 3 hits. Gains Cutify for itself: power permanently +20.

skills.name: 晒太阳
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels all of the enemy's buffs.

skills.name: 破罐破摔
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己有减益时，本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. When it has a debuff, this skill's power is +60.

skills.name: 示弱
skills.description: 自己获得萌化：速度永久+150。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains Cutify for itself: speed permanently +150.

skills.name: 月光合奏
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，双方携带的所有精灵每有1层萌化，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 hit. For each layer of Cutify on all creatures carried by both sides, this skill's hit count is +1.

skills.name: 击鼓传花
skills.description: 自己脱离，下个入场精灵继承自己增益。
skills.descriptionEn: Withdraws itself; the next creature to enter inherits its buffs.

skills.name: 阻断
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. In countering state: additionally interrupts the countered skill.
